subject: Post-demo: vendor routing & PO cutover — next steps

Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & quick vendor routing questions

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great discussion and some clear success criteria surfaced. Quick recap and asks so we can keep momentum while your team aligns internally: 

What we covered
- 30-min walkthrough of Redwood inference flow (hosted + dedicated options) and latency/cost profiles for your 3 use cases
- Demoed prefix caching and the preview billing dashboard you asked about
- Decision criteria you flagged: SLA for inference latency, data residency, and PO-based billing

Open items / asks
1) Economic buyer / approver: who will sign contracts and/or approve the PO? (I heard Peter Liu may be the final approver — can you confirm?)
2) Procurement path: do we need an SOW + PO or is a standard MSA + PO sufficient? Who receives the PO (billing email)?
3) Timeline: if procurement starts next week, what is your target cutover date for a pilot invoice?

Next steps from our side: I can pull together a short mutual action plan and a draft SOW for your legal to review. If you can confirm the PO routing + approver we’ll map dates.

Attachments: none in this note — will send MAP + SOW once you confirm the billing route.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0167

Ben —

Appreciate the recap, and happy to move forward. Quick answers: 
- Confirmed approver: Peter Liu (CFO) will need to approve any spend > $100k. I’ve cc'd him and procurement.
- Procurement path: we generally require an MSA + SOW and a PO for vendor setups. Legal will want to review the SOW and any data residency language.
- Billing contact: send PO to billing@medlytics.com and include our vendor code (ML-552) in the invoice reference.
- Timeline: procurement estimates ~3–4 weeks once we have the SOW + SOC2 evidence. If legal has redlines we add review time.

Please attach the SOW template and a light mutual action plan you mentioned. Also include the security checklist so our security ops has a view.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships | MedLytics

> Please attach the SOW template and a light mutual action plan you mentioned. Also include the security checklist so our security ops has a view.

Thanks for the quick clarifications — attaching two things to keep procurement moving:
- [attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 42KB)] — high-level milestones, owners, and target dates (pilot > PO > production rollout).
- [attachment: redwood-sow-template.docx (DOCX, 18KB)] — editable SOW draft for your legal team.

Short proposed cadence (from MAP):
- Week 0 (this week): MedLytics confirms approver + billing email (you already did — thanks)
- Week 1: Redwood submits SOW draft + SOC2 checklist
- Week 2–3: MedLytics legal & security review + redlines
- Week 3–4: PO issued to billing@medlytics.com -> pilot invoice cutover

Routing notes / options
- We can accept a PO referencing ML-552 and issue invoices quarterly or monthly per your preference.
- If you prefer faster start, we can invoice on Redwood Standard Terms and convert to PO within 30 days once the vendor intake is complete.

Action items for you (Alicia / procurement):
1) Confirm if a draft invoice is useful now (we can send a not-to-exceed pilot invoice).
2) Confirm legal contact for SOW redlines (who should we expect replies from?).
3) Any mandatory contract clauses (data retention, subprocessing, export controls) to pre-seed into the SOW?

I’ve looped in Monica (CS) for pilot onboarding details and Rishi (solutions) to answer any technical security questions.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Hi Ben / Alicia —

Thanks for the materials. A few items from procurement/legal before we can accept a PO: 
1) Please provide SOC 2 Type II report or a completed security checklist. If you don’t publish a report, the attached checklist must be filled by Redwood.
2) Send a draft invoice (PDF) referencing vendor code ML-552 and the following remittance: billing@medlytics.com.
3) Legal says they will review the SOW; typical turnaround is 5–7 business days after we receive the draft. If there are material redlines we’ll flag them.
4) Procurement prefers PO terms with net-30 payment; if Redwood requires a different term please indicate in the draft invoice and we’ll escalate to Peter for approval.

Please send the security-evidence-checklist.xlsx populated and the draft invoice by end of week so we can aim for the ~3-week procurement window discussed.

Thanks —
